name: josephdlmd/filament-storybook
description: Storybook for native Filament components: house patterns as PHP stories, a live catalogue page, and Boost MCP tools so AI agents reuse them instead of guessing.

suggest.laravel/boost: Gives AI agents the patterns, rules and checks as the storybook-list, storybook-show, storybook-instructions, storybook-test and storybook-audit MCP tools.
suggest.spatie/laravel-activitylog: Keeps the activity log the records-history pattern lists on a record's View page.
suggest.spatie/laravel-pdf: Makes the PDFs of the actions-download-pdf pattern, with spatie/browsershot and puppeteer for tagged PDFs.
